# sfcompute_infiniband_partition (Resource)

Manages an SF Compute infiniband partition (created with `POST /preview/v2/infiniband_partitions`; it cannot be updated in place, so any change replaces it).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sfcompute_infiniband_partition" "training" {
  name              = "training"
  region            = "europe-north1"
  availability_zone = "a"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `availability_zone` (String) Availability zone within the region. Required unless `fabric` is given; must match the fabric's availability zone when both are given.
- `fabric` (String) InfiniBand fabric to create this partition on, by name. Only instances whose instance SKU is on this fabric (the SKU's `infiniband_fabric`) can join the partition. Required when the availability zone has more than one fabric.
- `region` (String) Region to create this partition in. Required unless `fabric` is given; must match the fabric's region when both are given.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace to create this partition in. If omitted, the provider's `workspace` is used.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `id` (String) InfiniBand partition ID or resource path
- `resource_path` (String) A resource path for a infiniband_partition resource. Format: sfc:infiniband_partition:<account>:<workspace>:<name>.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sfcompute_infiniband_partition.training ibpart_k3RnX9vLm7Qp2Yw5Jd8F
```
